title: Constructible sheaves of modules on a qcqs scheme: global partition iff affine-local (Stacks 095E)
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The following are equivalent: (1) (Stacks 03RW(3)) for every affine open $U\subseteq T$ there is a finite partition $U=\coprod_iU_i$ of $U$ into pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets $U_i$ which are constructible subsets of $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that, giving $U_i$ its reduced induced subscheme structure with immersion $u_i:U_i\to T$, the inverse image $u_i^{-1}\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; (2) there is an open covering $T=\bigcup_jV_j$ such that each restriction $\mathcal F|_{V_j}$ satisfies (1) on the scheme $V_j$; (3) $\mathcal F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] (a finite partition of $T$ by constructible locally closed subsets with immersed schemes on whose inverse images $\mathcal F$ is finite locally constant).

source.place: Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), the statement for sheaves of Lambda-modules with Lambda Noetherian ('A similar statement holds'), here Lambda finite, and its proof; Stacks' condition 'of finite type and locally constant' in 03RW(3) is, for Lambda finite, the finite-locally-constant condition used here by lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values ((1) iff (3)); Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and the paragraph before it (reduced induced structure, topological invariance 03SI); uses Topology Lemma 09Y4 (topology-lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification), Topology Lemma 'quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-image', Properties Lemma 'locally-constructible'.

proof.text: Condition (1) implies (2): take the single-member open covering consisting of $T$ itself. No restriction or change of stratification is needed.

We record the three transfer facts used below, with $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda)$ as the category of values in [def-constructible-constant]. (a) Restriction. For an etale $e:E\to Y$ and a module sheaf $G$ on $Y_{\Et}$, [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] gives an isomorphism $e^{-1}G\cong G|_E$ of abelian sheaves, natural in $G$; naturality for the endomorphisms $\lambda:G\to G$, $\lambda\in\Lambda$, makes it $\Lambda$-linear, since the module structure of $e^{-1}G$ is given by the same functor of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] applied to these scalars (and sections of $\Lambda_E$ are locally constant). In particular an open restriction $\mathcal F|_{V}$ is the module inverse image along the open immersion $V\to T$. (b) Composition. For $v:Z\to Y$, $u:Y\to X$, [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (2) gives $v^{-1}u^{-1}\cong(u\circ v)^{-1}$, natural in the sheaf, hence $\Lambda$-linear by the same scalar-naturality argument. (c) Pullback. If $G$ is finite locally constant as a module sheaf in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] (b), i.e. (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values], then by (1) iff (2) there it is locally constant and finite for $\mathcal A$; for any morphism $h:Z\to Y$ of schemes, $h^{-1}G$ is locally constant by [lemma-constructible-pullback-locally-constant] and finite by [lemma-constructible-pullback-finite], so by (2) iff (1) again $h^{-1}G$ is finite locally constant in the module sense; [lemma-constructible-iso-invariance] lets us replace a sheaf by an isomorphic one (e.g. via (a), (b)). (d) Representatives. If two immersions into a scheme have the same image, the inverse image of a module sheaf along one is finite locally constant iff it is along the other, by [lemma-constructible-immersion-independence] (with the translation of (c)); this applies to the reduced induced representative of a locally closed subset.

Assume (2), with open cover $T=\bigcup_j V_j$. For each point $x$ choose $j$ with $x\in V_j$ and, by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], an affine open $W_x$ with $x\in W_x\subseteq V_j$. Quasi-compactness of $T$ means this open cover has a finite subcover $W_1,\ldots,W_r$ (if $T$ is empty use the empty cover). Each $W_a$ is also an affine open of $V_j$, so the hypothesis (1) on $V_j$ supplies a finite constructible locally closed partition of $W_a$ and reduced induced stratum immersions. Its finite locally constant module sheaves are exactly the inverse images of $\mathcal F$ along the composites into $T$, by the module composition comparison of step 2.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratification-local-gluing-core] to this finite affine cover and its local immersed stratifications. Its hypotheses are precisely quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $T$, affineness of the chosen opens, coverage, and constructibility of each local stratum in its chart. It yields a global finite constructible locally closed immersed stratification $S$, and for each stratum an ACTUAL scheme morphism to one local stratum, with its composite to $T$ equal to the global stratum immersion. Pull back the finite locally constant module sheaf on that local stratum along this morphism, using step 2. The result is the inverse image of $\mathcal F$ on the global stratum. Hence $S$ witnesses (3) by [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. This does not infer scheme-theoretic factorization merely from containment of images.

Assume (3), witnessed by immersed strata $Z_i\to T$ with constructible images $C_i$. Fix any affine open $U\subseteq T$. By [lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification], the base changes $Z_i\times_T U\to U$ give a finite locally closed partition with images $C_i\cap U$. These images are constructible IN $U$: for the inclusion $j:U\to T$, a retrocompact open $V\subseteq T$ has retrocompact inverse image in $U$, since a quasi-compact open $W$ of $U$ is a quasi-compact open of $T$ and $(V\cap U)\cap W=V\cap W$ is quasi-compact with the same subspace topology. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-preimage] applies to $j$ and $C_i$. Step 2 applied to $Z_i\times_T U\to Z_i$ gives finite local constancy with module coefficients; its same-image immersion clause transfers it to the reduced induced representative of $C_i\cap U$. This is exactly the partition required in (1). Empty intersections are harmless, and no intersection of affine opens was assumed affine.
The implications (1) to (2), (2) to (3), and (3) to (1) establish the asserted equivalence of all three conditions.
